messages:
nina: Noticing oddities: tenant t889 is pinned to v2 in console but we're seeing ~2% of traffic routed to v1 during bursts. Quotas look normal but customers see inconsistent feature behavior.
sam: Are they sending the X-Redwood-Client-Version header?
nina: Yes — header present in raw request. Sample from edge:
```
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1\nHost: api.redwood\nX-Redwood-Client-Version: 2.4.1\nX-Request-Id: r-abc123\n```
router decision log: tenant=t889 pinned=v2 final=v1 reason=route_swap overload_probe
```
dev-bot: alert: routing_anomaly tenant=t889 percent_routed_to_v1=2 window=15m id=alerts/9832
lee: Could be our overload_probe logic choosing v1 as a lower-latency fallback under specific seq_len distributions. We recently introduced a probe that considers queued_kv_cache_size.
pat: That probe was intended to be conservative. If it's causing customer-visible divergence we should: 1) make probe sample rate explicit in console; 2) show a timeline for "routed version" vs "pinned version"; 3) add a soft billing-smoothing for < 5% divergence.
sam: For telemetry, emit event: version_routing_event {tenant_id, client_version, pinned_version, routed_version, probe_triggered, seq_len_bkt, request_id, sample_rate}. Prefer snake_case.
lee: Console UX thought: route provenance pill -> hover shows "reason: overload_probe (last 5m x requests)" and an expand to timeline with sparkline. Also a tiny toggle: "pin enforcement (warn: capacity risk)".
nina: Billing ops flagged that v1 token counts are sometimes lower for same prompt shape, so small routing to v1 caused billing dips that confused customers on usage anomalies. We need a short-term guardrail.
pat: Proposed guardrail: when routed_version != pinned_version AND probe_triggered=true AND percent_routed < 10% -> mark events as "coexistence_maintenance" and cap billing delta reported to customer to +/- 5% for display only. Keep raw billing for ops.
sam: Config example (console/backend):
```
{
  "routing": {
    "overload_probe_sample_rate": 0.001,
    "coexistence_guard": {"enabled": true, "display_cap_pct": 5, "apply_if_percent_routed_lt": 10}
  }
}
```
lee: Data-platform: we'll accept version_routing_event with sample_rate and will create a dashboard tile. Add field probe_triggered:boolean and probe_name:string.
pat: Ops ticket opened: OPS-521 to add header-preservation rule on edge and OPS-522 to add temporary pinch point in router config.
nina: Action items: nina will add probe_trace logs and emit events (ETA: EOD); sam will add display_cap backend and endpoint for console (ETA: tomorrow); lee will mock the console pill + timeline (ETA: next week); pat will track ops tickets and runbook blurb.
sam: One more: ensure we log request_id and include it in console timeline links so CS can correlate.
lee: Agreed. Also add small notice in console: "Minor routing fallbacks may occur under load; refer to rollout runbook" with link.
nina: Thanks all. If anyone sees other tenants with >1% non-pinned routing, drop ids here.
